title: Keyboard focus gets stuck inside search box when adding a resource in inspector
body:
### Tested versions

does occur in 4.7 Beta 1
Does not occur in 4.7 dev snapshot 5

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon(TM) 890M Graphics (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.23033.1002) - AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M (24 threads) - 27.61 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When adding a resource to a property inside the inspector, if the list of resources to be added is greater than a certain number, a search box appears at the top of the menu and is automatically focused.
This prevents keyboard focus from moving inside the menu using the arrow keys, as the search box processes the keys as they would in edit boxes, making it impossible to select an item from the menu using the keyboard.

To reproduce, add any node that takes in a resource (with more than 10 resource types I believe?) in one of its properties, for example an AudioStreamPlayer, to the scene tree, then focus it so it shows in the inspector. Then, in the inspector, press the assign resource button. Alternatively, on a property which already has a resource assigned, press the edit button instead, as they seem to open the same menu. 
Since there are more than a certain number of resource types that can be assigned here, the menu will open with the focus on the search box. If you now press up or down arrow, the focus will remain inside the search box and not move to the menu items, meaning you're effectively trapped within this search box and cannot select a resource to add.

The expected behavior is that the up and down arrow keys will still allow you to navigate the menu and navigate past the search box to the menu items. If typing in this search box filters the results, then this should also work, so typing something to filter the menu should also mean that navigating after you have typed in this search box navigates the filtered results.

I am using a screen reader using Godot's AccessKit integration, so sorry if the reproduction steps are a bit confusing. I tried to make it as clear as I could, but I'm happy to clarify further if anything's unclear. This appears to be a new bug in beta 1 of 4.7. I have tested 4.7 dev snapshot 5, and there the menu is focusable, and no search box appears. 

### Steps to reproduce

* Add a node, for example AudioStreamPlayer3D, to the scene
* Focus it, so it shows in the inspector
* Navigate to the inspector, and assign resource to the stream property of the audio stream player
* It should open a menu with a search box focused
* Press up and down arrow and observe the focus remains within the edit box and does not move to the menu items

n/a
